implementationPlan.description:
Wire deltas into packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/getContext.ts.

Error handling: caller-shape errors throw INVALID_INPUT, and everything else falls back to a full packet; a delta path never throws.

Input schema:
- `basePacketId`: string, pattern ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$.
- `contextEpoch`: integer, minimum 0. The receiving session's compaction counter; a seat must advance it on every compaction.
Validate both before any read.

In servedContextIdentity, only on the 'recorded' path, after recordContextReceipt for the full result packet (text and packetId exactly as today):
- current = {attemptId, generation, sessionId, lastPhaseAt: attempt.lastPhaseAt, runner: processStartedAt and host ? `${processStartedAt}@${host}` : null}.
- stored = the store's get(deltaBaseKey(...)). The store comes from a module-level WeakMap<StateManager, DeltaBaseStore>, so a new StateManager (a restart) starts empty and tests stay isolated.
- decision = decideDelta({basePacketId, contextEpoch}, current, stored).
- When contextEpoch was presented, set the new base {packetId, text, ...current, contextEpoch}. Without an epoch, store nothing, so a later delta is impossible (fail closed).
- On a delta: return {delta: diffPackets(basePacketId, stored.text, packetId, text), servedContext: {...identity, receiptStatus:'recorded', receiptId, packetId, contextDelta:{served:'delta'}}}.
- Otherwise: return the full packet, with contextDelta {served:'full', reason} ONLY when the request presented basePacketId or contextEpoch. Unrecorded reads that present them get reason = receiptStatus.

Do not change the receipt shape, F06's packetId rule, view:'status', or reads that present neither field. Add one sentence to the tool description. docs/MCP_SERVER.md is left to the epic final C11's docs sweep; note that in the completion summary.

Make D1-D9 green.

implementationPlan.note:
Adversarial self-review of the diff (getContext.ts and getContextDelta.test.ts only). Nothing needed a code change.

Can a delta reach a session that might not hold the base?
- Restart: the WeakMap per StateManager starts empty (D4, M3).
- Reattach: lastPhaseAt moves (D7, M2).
- Re-claim or VM replacement: a new attempt or generation (attempt-mismatch), or another recorded runner (runner-changed).
- CLI respawn or another session: a new MOE_SESSION_ID (session-mismatch).
- Compaction: only through contextEpoch. A missing epoch never gets a delta and clears the base (D5, M1).
- Residual, theoretical: lastPhaseAt has ms resolution, so a reattach stamped in the same ms as the base's phase change (or a clock step back) would not move it. In-process reconcile only runs at startup, when the store is empty.

Does the reconstruction match the full packet?
- Diff and apply go by pointer on the parsed server text, and JSON.stringify drops undefined on both sides. D1 shows applyDelta(base, delta) toStrictEqual the full packet whose sha256 is servedContext.packetId.
- Clients must take the next base from servedContext.packetId and never re-hash, since key order differs.

Other checks:
- Concurrency: dispatch holds the global mutex, and the store get, decide and set run synchronously after the receipt await, so the last write wins. A stale base gets base-mismatch and the full packet.
- Memory: at most 256 entries, one per task, each one packet text. Nothing is stored until a seat sends contextEpoch.
- Legacy reads: the same keys in the same order, and the existing receipt and get_context suites pass unchanged.
- Inputs: null, NaN, Infinity, a negative or fractional epoch, and an uppercase or short id are each refused with INVALID_INPUT.
- Rails: the forbidden-token grep exits 1, and there were no .moe edits and no Git writes.

Wrote the Serena memories task-…-handoff and gotcha-get-context-packet-determinism. Seat-side epoch reporting (compaction-keeper mod plus proxy) is activation, not part of C06.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
1. One task holding the pure module plus the wiring. About 400 lines over 4 files, right at the cap on a shared wire contract. Split: the pure module became C06a (task-7d0f7f08, with the exact interface in its description), and C06 is the wiring.
2. Detecting compaction in the daemon. Impossible: compaction happens inside one CLI process, with the same MOE_SESSION_ID. So the contract requires an explicit contextEpoch that the seat advances on compaction, and the absence of an epoch never gives a delta (fail closed). Seat-side reporting (the moe-compaction-keeper session.compact hook plus proxy stamping) is activation and a client consumer, so it is out of scope.
3. Persisting bases. Rejected: in memory means a restart naturally gives a full snapshot (DoD2), and there is no new store.
4. Treating reattach as continuity. Rejected by DoD3. lastPhaseAt changes on every reconcile and reattach, so a base served before one never matches after it, without editing reattach_attempt.
5. C05 is kept in dependsOn per the directive, but NOT consumed: deltas are generic JSON diffs, so source-reference and evidence changes appear as changed fields.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
Landed:
- getContext.ts servedContextIdentity records a receipt only on the 'recorded' path (sessionId, a running attempt, owner = caller = assignee). packetId = sha256 of JSON.stringify(packet without servedContext).
- The attemptStore receipt is attempt.contextReceipt (latest wins). It records attemptId, generation, workerId, sessionId, packetId and planRevision.
- ExecutionAttempt.lastPhaseAt changes on every phase transition. processStartedAt and host are the runner identity.
- The seat sessionId is MOE_SESSION_ID `<workerId>@<preflight-iso>`, one per CLI launch, and stays the same across compactions.

- Receipt semantics: the receipt names the reconstructed full packet, which is what the session now holds (base + delta).
- Size is at most 400 net lines.
- Shared contract: run the full suite.

completionSummary:
CQ-C06: get_context now serves deltas against an acknowledged base. Files: src/tools/getContext.ts (+99/-8) and the new src/tools/getContextDelta.test.ts (+209, 19 tests), 300 net lines.

- New inputs: basePacketId (^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$) and contextEpoch (safe int >= 0). Bad values get INVALID_INPUT before any write.
- Only a recorded read with a matching base gets {delta, servedContext.contextDelta:{served:'delta'}}. Everything else gets the full packet, plus {served:'full', reason} when a field was sent.
- Bases live in a WeakMap<StateManager, DeltaBaseStore>, keyed per task id, so a restart starts empty.

DoD:
1. Removals are explicit `removed` pointers. D1 shows that applyDelta of the base and the delta equals the full packet the receipt names.
2. Full packet on:
   - a wrong base (base-mismatch, D2) or a missing one (no-base, base-unavailable; D3);
   - compaction (epoch-changed or epoch-missing, D5);
   - a VM replacement or re-claim (attempt-mismatch, runner-changed) or another session (session-mismatch), all D6;
   - a restart (D4).
3. A reattach is not acknowledgement: the moved lastPhaseAt gives phase-changed (D7).
4. Gate green.

Deviations:
- Bases are keyed per task, not by deltaBaseKey. That key would make D6's session-mismatch and attempt-mismatch unreachable, so C06a's deltaBaseKey export is unused.
- C06a checks no-base before base-unavailable, so an epoch-only read is 'no-base'.
- A recorded read without an epoch deletes the base (fail closed).

Mutants: 7, all killed (no-epoch store, stale phase, global store, legacy contextDelta, deltaBaseKey keying, unrecorded contextDelta, no id pattern).

Legacy reads are unchanged. Nothing sends contextEpoch yet; seat-side stamping (compaction-keeper plus proxy) is activation. docs/MCP_SERVER.md is left to C11. C07 backed its getContext.ts hunk out and waits on C06.
